desc: Ideate and select complement multiset enumeration over no-zero digit multisets as the preferred approach.
Implement `count_upto(n)` using complement multiset enumeration as described, including factorial/multinomial helpers and lexicographic permutation counting.
Test the provided examples and edge cases: `l=r` single digits, ranges containing zeros, `n=0`, `n=10`, `n=999999999`, and verify no leading-zero or zero-number miscounts.
